ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) distribution with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters localized to scars and barnacles; ratio heavily skewed towards dark pixels (>85%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dark contiguous region covering 90% of the fluke surface; high-contrast white circular spots scattered medially; diagonal light-grey linear striations localized to the mid-right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an estimated interior angle of 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge boundary, ranging from 3 to 15 pixel amplitudes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to the outer lateral margins of both lobes, tapering toward distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized cluster of high-intensity, textured circular pixels on the upper-left distal tip; scattered discrete white circular points across the lower-medial lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of at least six parallel diagonal linear disruptions (light-grey) on the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent diagonal rake marks on the right lobe; active barnacle colonization on the superior margin of the left lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Raised three-dimensional barnacle cluster on the extreme distal tip of the left lobe lobe.
